lessons.title: Curvature and holonomy groups
lessons.proof_status: Sections 14–15 prove the full K and K1 identifications and bilinear compatibility for the real and underlying real complex sl2 plus so(n) tensor series, n at least 3; all smooth reduced connection germs are analytic in suitable coordinates and are determined by their first three curvature jets. The cotangent Poisson realization and framed local converse include arbitrary-rank and singular initial parameters, with holonomy equality asserted only under the displayed curvature-span condition. General affine and Riemannian classification exhaustion remains unfinished.

lessons.title: Symmetric Lie algebras and Hermitian symmetric spaces
lessons.proof_status: Section 12 supplies full root production for every finite-dimensional complex semisimple Lie algebra: complete reducibility, finite sl2 modules, maximal-toral Cartans and their conjugacy, opposite-root pairings, normalized coroot triples, one-dimensional root spaces, reducedness, complete strings, reflection closure, integral pairings and a positive real inverse-Killing metric. Eight full solved checks and an exact original sl3 illustration accompany the proof. Sections 10–11 provide all finite positive Cartan diagrams and abstract root-system classification. Lie reconstruction and converse existence, real forms and symmetric-space exhaustion remain active.
